t2.text: 2 · Label and check one moment (3 cameras)

n1.text:
BACKEND NEEDS — open

• One call: open(folder) → recording | parent-with-candidates | project | error.
• Candidate fields: name, path, layout (synchronized_videos/ or videos/synchronized/), camera count, frame count, calibration file + format, issues[] (specific, human-readable).
• One recents list mixing recordings, folders and existing projects: kind, path, last opened, camera count, calibration state.
• Existing *_project.json still opens via 'Open existing project…'.

n2.text:
BACKEND NEEDS — label one moment

• Cameras: stable id, video path, width×height, frame_count, timing (fps or timestamps).
• Shared frame index + source-frame identity.
• Per-camera calibration state: calibrated | none | needs-match | size-mismatch.
• Observation = (target, point name/index, camera_id, source_frame, x, y px, origin: click | accepted | prediction[model, confidence]).
• Projections are DERIVED on read, never stored as observations.
• triangulate(target, point, frame) → 3D, per-camera reprojection, error px, which cameras were used.
• Session: frame, active point, active camera, layout.

n3.text:
BACKEND DECISIONS — missing evidence

• Ambiguous match: discovery returns, per video, candidate camera ids + reason (name, size).
• Proposed 'test assignments': given one point clicked in every video, score each permutation by reprojection error. Needs a call that accepts a hypothetical video→camera mapping.
• Frame mismatch: per-stream frame_count + first divergent frame if known; list which operations are disabled for that stream.
• No calibration: everything 2D still saves; triangulate returns a clear 'no calibration' state, not an error.

n4.text:
LATER — rigid / STL

• Target type: points | rigid | mesh. Changing type keeps all clicks.
• Rigid: reference landmarks from typed coords or from one well-labeled frame.
• Mesh: STL path, units, hash, point → mesh coordinate bindings.
• fit_pose(frame) needs ≥3 non-collinear observed landmarks; returns RMS px + per-view overlay.
• Depth assist only when a ZED depth stream exists; existing ZED/STL projects keep working.

n5.text:
LATER — train + refine (step 5)

Enters through the existing 'Training data' and 'Train & review' tabs.
• Training data picks labeled camera-frames (any camera count), point order = target order.
• Analysis results come back into THIS Label view as model predictions (hollow diamonds + confidence).
• Correcting = clicking: a click replaces the prediction and becomes an observed point.
